item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Modi violated term limits or bypassed constitutional transfer rules.\nThat is partly because India’s Prime Minister does not have a fixed constitutional term limit in the first place; the operative standard is whether the leader retains parliamentary confidence and follows election/succession procedures.","evidence":[{"title":"Constitution of India, Article 75","publisher":"WIPO Lex","date":"n.d. (current text)","url":"https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/text/494905","summary":"The constitutional text provides for the Prime Minister to be appointed by the President and does not set a fixed PM term. That means the 2024 question is mainly whether Modi respected election results, coalition succession, and constitutional transfer, not whether he hit a term cap.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"India’s president invites Modi to head new coalition government, swearing-in on Sunday","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"7 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-president-invites-modi-to-head-new-coalition-government-swearing-in-on-sunday/2121711/","summary":"After the BJP fell short of a solo majority, Modi accepted President Murmu’s invitation to form a government and publicly framed the new NDA coalition as a shared governing arrangement. This is strong evidence of constitutional succession through established channels.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"India’s Modi sworn in as PM for third term, faces coalition challenges","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"9 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-sworn-in-as-prime-minister-for-historic-third-term/2123770/","summary":"Modi took the oath of office at Rashtrapati Bhavan after the election setback, showing a clean constitutional transfer rather than any extra-constitutional attempt to retain power.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"India PM Modi’s key allies stand by him despite surprise weaker showing in election","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"4 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/india-pm-modis-key-allies-stand-by-him-despite-surprise-weaker-showing-in-election/2116174/","summary":"Two key regional allies said their pre-poll alliance with Modi’s BJP remained intact and they would form the next government. This supports a finding that succession occurred through coalition continuity rather than rupture.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"Modi’s allies want funds, cabinet positions as coalition gears to form new government","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"6 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/modis-allies-want-funds-cabinet-jobs-as-india-coalition-talks-begin-3472931","summary":"Coalition partners demanded funds and cabinet positions as the new government was formed. This is weak counterevidence because it shows coalition commitments were bargaining-heavy and not purely programmatic.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"India’s Modi prevails over allies in cabinet line-up","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"11 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-prevails-over-allies-in-cabinet-line-up/2126130/","summary":"Modi kept all key cabinet ministries in the same hands, indicating he retained strong personal control even while relying on allies for a parliamentary majority. This is a mild negative signal for coalition power-sharing, but not evidence of constitutional breach.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"18th Lok Sabha session begins | Consensus crucial to govern, aim to take everyone along: PM Modi","publisher":"The Indian Express","date":"25 Jun 2024","url":"https://indianexpress.com/article/india/18th-lok-sabha-session-consensus-crucial-to-govern-aim-to-take-everyone-along-pm-modi-9412819/","summary":"Modi said consensus was essential and that the NDA had been given another chance. This is modest positive evidence that he publicly acknowledged the need to govern within a coalition/parliamentary framework.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"India’s Modi set to win historic third term but with surprisingly slim majority","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"4 Jun 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-set-to-win-historic-third-term-but-with-surprisingly-slim-majority/2116973/","summary":"Reuters reported that the BJP lost its outright majority and would need coalition partners. This is important context: the 2024 result itself forced Modi into coalition rule, which is exactly the kind of constitutional constraint this lens looks for.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]}]}
